extName.description: Extension name, shown in Chrome and the Chrome Web Store. Max 75 characters.

extDescription.message: Speichere Jobs von LinkedIn, Indeed und anderen Seiten mit einem Klick und verfolge alle Bewerbungen an einem Ort.
extDescription.description: Extension description for the Chrome Web Store. MUST be under 132 characters.

popupBrand.description: Short app name in the popup header.

openDashboard.description: Popup button that opens the dashboard in a new tab. The arrow means 'opens elsewhere'.

fieldTitle.description: Form label for the job title.

fieldCompany.description: Form label for the company name.

fieldLocation.description: Form label for the job location (city, country, or Remote).

fieldLink.description: Form label for the job post web address.

fieldStatus.description: Form label for the application status.

fieldDateApplied.description: Form label for the date the user applied.

fieldNotes.description: Form label for free notes about the job.

notesPlaceholder.description: Example text inside the empty notes field.

saveJob.description: Popup button to save a new job.

updateJob.description: Popup button to save changes to a job that is already saved.

statusSaved.description: Status: the job is saved, but the user has not applied yet.

statusApplied.description: Status: the user sent an application.

statusInterview.description: Status: the user has an interview.

statusOffer.description: Status: the user received a job offer.

noticeCantRead.message: Diese Seite kann nicht gelesen werden. Du kannst den Job trotzdem von Hand eintragen.
noticeCantRead.description: Popup warning on pages like chrome:// or the new tab page.

noticeAlreadySaved.description: Popup notice when the job is already saved. $DATE$ is a formatted date.

noticeUsedTitle.message: Wir haben den Seitentitel verwendet. Bitte prüfe die Angaben.
noticeUsedTitle.description: Popup warning when only the page title was found.

noticeNoDetails.message: Keine Jobdetails gefunden. Bitte trage sie selbst ein.
noticeNoDetails.description: Popup warning when nothing was found on the page.

noticeJobSaved.description: Success message after saving a new job.

noticeJobUpdated.description: Success message after updating a saved job.

errorTitleRequired.description: Error when the job title is empty.

errorBadLink.message: Der Link muss mit http:// oder https:// beginnen
errorBadLink.description: Error when the link is not a web address. Keep http:// and https:// as they are.

errorSaveFailed.message: Der Job konnte nicht gespeichert werden. Bitte versuche es erneut.

errorDuplicateLink.description: Error when another saved job has the same link. $TITLE$ is that job's title.

errorJobGone.message: Dieser Job existiert nicht mehr. Vielleicht wurde er in einem anderen Tab gelöscht.
errorJobGone.description: Error when the job being edited was deleted meanwhile.

jobCountOne.description: Total number of saved jobs, when there is exactly 1.

addJob.description: Dashboard button to add a job by hand.

exportCsv.description: Dashboard button to download all jobs as a CSV file. Keep 'CSV'.

languageLabel.description: Accessible label of the language picker.

toolbarLabel.description: Accessible label of the toolbar with filters, search and sort.

filtersLabel.description: Accessible label of the group of filter buttons.

filterAll.description: Filter button that shows all jobs.

filterFollowUp.description: Filter button that shows jobs that may need a follow-up.

searchPlaceholder.description: Example text inside the empty search box.

searchLabel.description: Accessible label of the search box.

sortLabel.description: Accessible label of the sort menu.

sortSavedDesc.description: Sort option: newest saved jobs first.

sortSavedAsc.description: Sort option: oldest saved jobs first.

sortAppliedDesc.description: Sort option: most recent application date first.

sortUpdatedDesc.description: Sort option: most recently changed jobs first.

sortCompanyAsc.description: Sort option: by company name, alphabetically.

sortTitleAsc.description: Sort option: by job title, alphabetically.

sortStatus.description: Sort option: by status (Saved, Applied, Interview, Offer, Rejected).

colSaved.description: Table column header: the date the job was saved.

colApplied.description: Table column header: the date the user applied.

colActions.description: Table column header for the Edit and Delete buttons (only read by screen readers).

bannerFollowUpOne.message: ⏰ 1 Bewerbung wurde vor $DAYS$+ Tagen gesendet, ohne Antwort.
bannerFollowUpOne.description: Banner when exactly 1 application needs a follow-up. $DAYS$ is a number, like 7.

bannerFollowUpOther.message: ⏰ $COUNT$ Bewerbungen wurden vor $DAYS$+ Tagen gesendet, ohne Antwort.
bannerFollowUpOther.description: Banner when 2 or more applications need a follow-up. $DAYS$ is a number, like 7.

showThem.description: Banner button that shows only the jobs that need a follow-up.

followUpBadge.description: Small label on a job applied 7+ days ago.

followUpTooltip.description: Tooltip of the follow-up label. $DAYS$ is 7 or more.

untitledJob.description: Shown when a job has no title.

thisJob.description: Used inside other sentences when a job has no title, like 'Delete this job'.

statusFor.description: Accessible label of a row's status menu.

editJobLabel.description: Accessible label of a row's Edit button.

deleteJobLabel.description: Accessible label of a row's Delete button.

confirmDelete.description: Confirmation question before deleting a job.

emptyNoJobsText.message: Öffne eine Stellenanzeige auf LinkedIn, Indeed oder einer Karriereseite und klicke auf das Erweiterungssymbol, um sie zu speichern.
emptyNoJobsText.description: Help text of the empty dashboard. Keep LinkedIn and Indeed.

emptyNoMatchTitle.message: Keine Jobs passen zu deinen Filtern
emptyNoMatchTitle.description: Title when the filters or search hide all jobs.

emptyNoMatchText.message: Wähle einen anderen Status oder lösche die Suche.
emptyNoMatchText.description: Help text when the filters or search hide all jobs.

dialogAddTitle.description: Title of the dialog for a new job.

dialogEditTitle.description: Title of the dialog for editing a job.

cancel.description: Button that closes the dialog without saving.

alertNoJobsToExport.message: Es gibt noch keine Jobs zum Exportieren.
alertNoJobsToExport.description: Message when the user clicks Export CSV with no saved jobs.

csvTitle.description: CSV file column header: job title.

csvDateSaved.description: CSV file column header: the date the job was saved.

csvDateApplied.description: CSV file column header: the date the user applied.

csvLink.description: CSV file column header: the job post web address.

adSponsored.description: Small label on every ad card. It must be clear that the card is an ad.
